model: SCD30 CO2, humidity and temperature sensor module
applies_to: Sensirion SCD30 sensor module with the SEL pin pulled high at power-up (Modbus mode), per interface description version 1.0.
summary: The SCD30 is an NDIR CO2 module with on-board humidity and temperature sensing. With the SEL pin tied to VDD it speaks Modbus RTU (UART level) at a fixed address and baud rate. Measurements are big-endian IEEE-754 floats; configuration commands are single 16-bit register writes.

addressing.note: Addresses are given in hex exactly as they appear in the request frames (for example 0x61 0x03 0x00 0x28 reads from 0x0028), so they are wire addresses.

source.title: Interface Description Sensirion SCD30 Sensor Module
source.pages: Modbus settings p. 6; command set pp. 7-15; read measurement example p. 11; firmware p. 14; soft reset p. 15

notes: The read-measurement example returns 43 DB 8C 2E (439 ppm), 41 D9 E7 FF (27.2 °C) and 42 43 3A 1B (48.8 %RH), and the document states the values are big-endian floats, so all three are high word first.
The sensor accepts function codes 3, 4 and 6 only; there is no multi-register write.
The Modbus address 0x61 (97) and 19200 8N1 are fixed in this document; no command to change them is listed.
The UART pins are at logic level; an RS-485 transceiver is needed to put the module on a bus.

registers.name: Firmware version
registers.description: High byte = major, low byte = minor.

registers.name: Measurement interval
registers.description: Continuous measurement interval, 2 to 1800 s (default 2 s).

registers.name: Data ready status
registers.description: 1 when a new measurement can be read.

registers.name: Start continuous measurement
registers.description: Write ambient pressure 700-1400 mbar, or 0 to start without pressure compensation.

registers.name: Altitude compensation
registers.description: Height above sea level in metres.

registers.name: Forced recalibration reference
registers.description: Reference CO2 concentration 400-2000 ppm for forced recalibration.

registers.name: Temperature offset
registers.description: Offset for the on-board RH/T sensor in 0.01 °C steps.

integration.summary: Write 0 (or the ambient pressure in mbar) to 0x0036 once to start measuring; the setting survives power cycles. Then poll 0x0027 for data ready and read six registers from 0x0028 for CO2, temperature and humidity.
integration.enable: Pull the SEL pin to VDD during power-up to select Modbus instead of I2C.
quirks: The manual's read example fetches all six measurement registers from 0x0028 in one request (CO2, temperature, humidity, each high word first).
setup: Power up with SEL high, connect TX/RX through a suitable transceiver, then send the start command.
gotchas: Continuous measurement and ASC states are stored in non-volatile memory and resume after power-up.

address_note: address = 0-based Modbus wire (PDU) address; documented = as printed in the source.
note: Re-typed from the manufacturer's public documentation (see source) and verified against it. Registers vary by firmware and options; verify against the live device before writing.
